# G2: MMT pilot measurements

Lag intervals use the previous valid poll without the actual and first flagged actual receipt; first sightings without a preceding poll count as published but are excluded from lag fitting. A later flagged actual proves an omitted event happened: terminated runs contribute epsilon counterexamples; unfinished runs are right-censored at last valid poll minus the later actual. Events with no later actual are excluded; ETAs never establish event truth. The body uses Kaplan-Meier with interval midpoints, and the exponential tail above observed P90 uses censored exposure. These measurements are not a source guarantee. The tail remains soft. Minute display uses provisional truncation.

Freshness and capacity acceptance remain a user decision. Rerun G7(d) with the epsilon CI upper bound and twice the tail scale.
